question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 1
question: All credit relationships are subject to reviews on at least an annual basis, in the form of either an 'Abbreviated' or a 'Full' Credit Review

options.A: True

discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 2
question: An Abbreviated Annual Review is allowable for relationships with Total Facilities of what amount or less, within the business unit's target market, adhering to approved Risk Acceptance Criteria, with no classified facilities?

options.A: N10 million

discussion: Selected Answer: D. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.1.

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 3
question: Relationships where all facilities are cash collateralized shall also undergo which type of review?

options.A: No review is required for fully cash-collateralized relationships
options.B: A review only once every 3 years
options.D: Full Credit Review only, with no abbreviation permitted

discussion: Selected Answer: C. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.1.

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 4
question: Facilities below N5 million will only be approved under which mechanism?

options.A: No facility below N5 million may be approved at all

discussion: Selected Answer: B. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.1.

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 5
question: At a minimum, an Abbreviated Credit Review must include which of the following?

options.A: A Risk Trends summary, facility appropriateness check, collateral reaffirmation, and updated risk ratings
options.B: Only a one-line confirmation that the facility remains outstanding
options.C: Nothing beyond the previous year's review, copied forward unchanged
options.D: Only a signature from the Relationship Manager, with no further content

discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.1.
community_answer: A. A Risk Trends summary, facility appropriateness check, collateral reaffirmation, and updated risk ratings

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 6
question: A Full Credit Review is required every year for which relationships?

options.A: Any relationship not meeting Abbreviated-only criteria, or flagged by Portfolio Review
options.D: None, if an Abbreviated Review was done last year

discussion: Selected Answer: D. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.2.
community_answer: D. None, if an Abbreviated Review was done last year

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 7
question: A Full Credit Review must include the standard Credit Analysis criteria

options.A: True

discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.2.

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 8
question: The approval requirement for a Full Credit Review is the same as that required for:

options.A: No approval is required once the review document is filed
options.B: A new credit facility, per the Credit Approval Grid
options.C: Only a rubber-stamp sign-off with no reference to the approval grid
options.D: Board of Directors approval, regardless of facility size

discussion: Selected Answer: B. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.2.

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 9
question: At any time, may a credit approval authority or the Chief Risk Officer determine that a more frequent review cycle is appropriate for a particular relationship, geography, industry or business?

options.A: Yes — this discretion exists regardless of the Abbreviated/Full criteria otherwise applicable
options.B: No, the review cycle is always fixed at exactly 12 months with no exceptions
options.C: Only the Board of Directors may make this determination, not the CRO or approval authorities
options.D: This discretion applies only to relationships below N1 million

discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed against section 6.8.1.
community_answer: A. Yes — this discretion exists regardless of the Abbreviated/Full criteria otherwise applicable

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 10

options.A: True

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 11

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 12
question: Which of the following risks should a comprehensive collateral insurance program cover, per the CPG?

options.A: No specific risk types are named — coverage is left entirely to the customer's discretion

options.C: Only theft, with fire and weather-related risks excluded

question: Does acceptance of an unadvised facility require the same Board Resolution as an advised facility?

question_no: Annual Review Types, Collateral Insurance & Foundational Credit Principles - Question 17

question: According to the CPG, should equal or unequal attention be paid to quantifiable versus non-quantifiable risks?
